_readme: Official sources the radar should watch. 'feed_url' is EMPTY on purpose where we could not verify a machine-readable feed address from this environment (gov sites blocked automated reads). Fill feed_url ONLY with an address you opened yourself. Never add non-government sources here - those need officer approval anyway.

sources.name: NDMA SACHET (national CAP alerts)
sources.notes: Best source: CAP RSS feeds exist per the portal description; exact feed URL to be confirmed by M3 from the portal's own CAP RSS link.

sources.name: IMD Mausam (weather warnings)
sources.notes: District/sub-division warnings with colour codes. Page is dynamic; needs TinyFish Fetch/Agent.

sources.name: INCOIS (tsunami / ocean alerts)
sources.notes: Tsunami bulletins from the Indian Tsunami Early Warning Centre.

sources.name: National Center for Seismology
sources.notes: Latest earthquake list with magnitude, depth, place.

sources.name: GSI Bhusanket (landslide susceptibility)
sources.notes: Susceptibility maps, not a live warning feed.

sources.name: Forest Survey of India (fire alerts)
sources.notes: Agency verified via FSI Van Agni and SACHET.
